artworks.title: Wayside Inn—Oaks in Spring
artworks.description: This image shows a black and white etching of a large tree dominating the scene. The horizon is high in the image, revealing a vast landscape that extends beyond the tree. In the background, there are more trees and distant hills. The tree and surrounding foliage are detailed with cross-hatched lines to show texture and shadow. A rough path is visible on the ground, with sunlight casting shadows from the tree's limbs. The image has a monochromatic palette, focusing on line work to provide depth and dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: Old Lace
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a small bridge and a village in the background. Two boats are floating on the water. The stone bridge crosses the water, with trees and houses in the village behind it. The artwork features detailed lines creating texture in the stonework, water, and trees. The color scheme is monochromatic, using various shades of black, white, and grey.

artworks.title: Toby's, Cos Cob
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a grand building. The artwork depicts an elaborately detailed facade of a two-story building with a porch or balcony running along its length. The lower floor features multiple, paned windows, adorned with a repeating arch pattern beneath a railing on the upper balcony. A large tree stands to the side, with its branches casting intricate shadows over the structure and ground. In the foreground, there is a cart or wagon, detailed with large wheels and a decorative panel.

artworks.title: House on the Main Street, Easthampton
artworks.description: The image shows a house partially hidden by large trees, with the trees dominating the upper portion of the scene. A wooden fence separates the viewer from the house. The house has multiple visible windows, suggesting it is two stories with a porch. The artwork features detailed line work creating texture and depth through cross-hatching and varied line density. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and white, emphasizing contrast and shadow.

artworks.title: Walt Whitman's Birthplace
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with a house in the center, slightly to the right. The horizon is high in the composition, focusing on the immediate surroundings. There are no prominent elements directly on the horizon. The artwork features intricate linework with crosshatching techniques for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a cream or off-white background. A wooden fence runs parallel to a dirt path leading to the house, surrounded by trees with foliage framing the scene.

artworks.title: The Laughing Audience
artworks.description: The image depicts various people in a detailed engraving style. In the upper portion, there are two women on the left and a man wearing a coat and spectacles engaged in conversation, and another playful couple to their right. In the lower half, several men are shown standing or seated with varied expressions. The background includes textured wall details and paneling, indicating a social setting.

artworks.title: Four Heads from the Raphael Cartoons at Hampton Court
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of four men, each depicted from the shoulders up in various poses. The man on the left has a beard and short hair, looking to the right. The second man from the left has curly hair and faces right with a neutral expression. The third man has longer curly hair and a beard, looking directly at the viewer with his face partially in shadow. The man on the right has a full beard and wears a head wrap, facing left with eyes nearly closed. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed features and expressions of the four men.

artworks.title: Henry Colthurst
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the bust of a person. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the left with their head turned towards the viewer. They have a young face with softly defined features, thin lips, and large eyes. Their hair is medium-length, reaching just past the chin, and appears to be wavy or slightly curled. The person is wearing what seems to be a period garment, possibly a jerkin or doublet, and a high collar is visible underneath. The background of the image features a large helmet and a small detailed figure. The background around the central figure is plain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: This is a waist-length portrait of a man positioned forward, staring directly towards the viewer. His facial features include a solemn expression with deep-set eyes, and he has shoulder-length, wavy hair framing his face. He is wearing a wide-collared, dark garment that is fastened with buttons down the front. The image is encased within an ornate oval frame adorned with scrollwork and designs. Below the frame, there is a decorative cartouche featuring a shield with three fleur-de-lis and what appears to be a mountain or hill. The portrait is done in a vintage engraving style.

artworks.title: Woman with a Ruff in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a person in profile facing to the right. The person has a prominent nose and high cheekbones, with neatly styled hair possibly pulled back with intricate detailing around the ear area. They are wearing an elaborate garment with a ruffled collar, patterned trim on the shoulders and sleeves, and no visible jewelry. The background features a circular frame with a crosshatch design, and the artwork appears to be an etching with a signature and date, "W. Hollar fecit 1643," on the lower left side outside the frame.

artworks.title: Hans von Zurch, Goldsmith
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This image depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is seated with his body turned slightly to the side, facing forward. The man has a long, oval face with pronounced cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and slightly parted lips. He is wearing a large, soft hat that covers his hair and drapes over his shoulders. The man is dressed in a period outfit, including a shirt with a high collar and a voluminous jacket made of heavy fabric. The background is plain, drawing focus to the man's features and clothing. Text appears in a decorative border at the top, revealing the subject and the artist.

artworks.title: The Canal
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Pieter Brueghel the Younger
artworks.description: The image features a village road stretching into the distance, lined with trees and buildings. The drawing uses detailed line work to depict textures in the scene. The color scheme is monochromatic in tones of black and grey. Villagers are shown engaging in various activities, with horse-drawn carts and wagons present. More figures and structures can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Margaret Lemon
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned in a three-quarter view, looking towards the viewer with her head turned slightly over her shoulder. Her facial features are delicately illustrated, with a composed expression, and she has curly hair adorned with flowers on one side. She is wearing an elegant gown with flowing, draped fabric. Around her neck is a simple pearl necklace. In her hand, she is holding a bouquet of flowers. The background is plain, with a textured pattern. Below the image, there is a text inscription naming her as "Margverite Lemon Angloise," alongside a poem or text in French.

artworks.title: Henry van der Borcht, Painter
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to the side, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has long, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders and a mustache. His facial expression is neutral. He is clothed in a garment with a large collar and button detail. He is holding an open book with his left hand, and the page is visible to the viewer, showing briefly sketched figures. The background is a simple textured pattern without distinct objects.

artworks.title: The Morning Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals crossing a bridge. The artwork depicts a wooden plank bridge over water, leading to a building with a steep roof and a bell. The scene is framed by a tree with detailed branches and pine needles. On the bridge and in the foreground, several figures can be seen walking, some carrying buckets. The clothing of the figures suggests a historical period, characterized by long skirts, shawls, and brimmed hats. The drawing captures the atmosphere of the setting, with attention to detail in the architecture, natural setting, and attire.

artworks.title: Making Hay
artworks.description: The scene depicts activities in a meadow. A man with a scythe is cutting grass, with another man doing the same in the background. Two figures are seated on the grass on the right. The illustration uses fine lines and cross-hatching, giving a textured appearance. The color palette is in sepia tones, typical of traditional engraving techniques, evoking a sense of history. The horizon is visible with distant trees blending into the sky.

artworks.title: On the Beach - Two are Company, Three are None
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing on a beach, looking towards the sea. She has long hair tucked under a hat and wears a voluminous dress with ruffles and long sleeves, cinched at the waist with a sash. She holds a dark parasol in her right hand. In the background, there is the ocean with gentle waves breaking at the shore. Two figures sit in a small boat on the sand, and seagulls fly above. Grasses frame the scene in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ship-Building, Gloucester Harbor
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with a large, partially constructed ship in the background. Workers are engaged in various tasks around the ship. In the foreground, a group of figures, possibly children, are gathered around, some sitting on timber. One of them is holding a small model sailboat. The scene suggests a busy shipyard environment focused on shipbuilding activities.

artworks.title: The Nooning
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with children and a dog resting outdoors. The image depicts a tranquil rural setting where a dog relaxes on the grass beside two children; one is lying down while wearing a wide-brimmed hat, another is sitting cross-legged, and there is a third child sitting a little further away. In the background, there is a small house surrounded by trees, and laundry is strung up on a line, fluttering in the breeze. A person can be seen doing an activity near the house.

artworks.title: Spring Farm Work - Grafting
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a ladder placed against a tree, engaged in an activity with his hands. He appears focused, wearing a dark hat, a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and trousers. There is a grafting tool or knife near him, as well as a piece of rope or belt around his waist. The background features a rural setting with a bare tree, barns or storage buildings, stacks of hay or straw, and a few birds or chickens on the ground.

artworks.title: New England Factory Life - Bell-Time
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd of people walking away from a large industrial building. The illustration depicts a substantial group of individuals, all appearing to hold or carry small containers. In the background is a vast, long building with many windows and a prominent cupola on the roof. The scene is busy and bustling, further emphasized by the denseness of the crowd. The background shows a treeline along with a sky filled with horizontal lines. The drawing style is intricate with detailed line work to depict the clothing and features of the figures.

artworks.title: Fire Works on the Night of the Fourth of July
artworks.description: The image depicts a large crowd of people, with each person shown from the shoulders up. The individuals have varying facial features, with men generally sporting facial hair and most wearing top hats or other headwear, while women wear their hair up and are adorned with hats. The clothing appears formal and includes suits and shawls typical of the era. Among the crowd, a man holds a cane. The background is filled with more onlookers, creating a dense crowd scene, and in the distant background, trees and fireworks light up the night sky.

artworks.title: The Dinner Horn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman standing outside a small structure resembling a barn or farmhouse, holding a large horn to her lips. A cat is beside her, and the scene includes farm equipment and animals in the distance. The structure has various objects inside, including a large sack. Ivy creeps up the sides of the building, and a grassy area extends from its step, depicting a rural setting.
